dentures.entity_type_flag: MISCLASSIFIED: 'dentures' is a dental appliance/medical device, not a health condition — confirmed by its own aliases (artificial teeth, false teeth, dental prosthetics). The existing ladder invents 'dental prosthesis condition' as an intermediate level, which does not correspond to any real diagnostic category in ICD-10 or SNOMED CT — it appears to be a fabricated placeholder rather than a genuine ontology node (compare to the drug/procedure/condition entities elsewhere in this corpus, which map to real ATC/ICD-10/DOID/SNOMED entries). This is the third instance of this failure pattern found in this corpus (see also 'crestor' — drug misfiled as health-condition, and 'aging process' — biological process misfiled as medical-procedure). Recommend: (1) re-type to a device/appliance namespace if one exists in the schema, or create one; (2) if a health-condition relationship is independently useful (e.g. 'edentulism' / tooth loss, the condition dentures address — ICD-10 K08.1), model that as a separate, correctly-named entry rather than folding the device into the condition ladder.
